Black Friday / Cyber Monday 2026 · checked 2026-10-31

The Black Friday VPS price isn’t what you pay at renewal.

Answer: The Black Friday price is not what you pay at renewal. 5 vendors show a price on their own page today (RackNerd, Hostinger, AwakeHost, ScalaHosting, Bluehost). Only RackNerd says its plans renew at the same price; its 4 GB KVM VPS special is the lowest 3-year cash for 4 GB in our table ($179.97). Hostinger, AwakeHost, ScalaHosting, Bluehost renew higher. As of 2026-10-31, Hostinger's VPS sale (runs Oct 19 – Dec 14, 2026) lists KVM 2 (2 vCPU / 8 GB) at $8.79/mo, but only on a 24-month prepay ($210.96 today). It renews at $14.99/mo (+71%) for the same 24-month term, billed up front again ($359.76), so keeping it past 2 years costs $570.72 in cash by month 25. If you can’t prepay 24 months: OVHcloud VPS-1 (2 vCPU / 4 GB, $5.35/mo, no commitment) costs less than Hostinger KVM 1 at 1, 2 and 3 years ($192.60 vs $443.52 over 3 years).

Planned re-checks

We re-read every vendor page above on Nov 27 (Black Friday) and Nov 30 (Cyber Monday), update this table, and log every price, renewal or end-date change in the dated price log (RSS).

How to judge any Black Friday VPS deal

  • Find the renewal price and the term it renews for. If it renews for the same 24-month term, that whole term is billed up front at month 25.
  • Ask “same price at renewal?” Only a vendor quote counts; we show it per row.
  • Find the prepay. “$8.79/mo” billed as $210.96 today is a 24-month commitment.
  • Compare 3-year cash, not the headline monthly rate, against a monthly-billed plan you could leave any time.
  • Count the extras: backups (included at Hostinger, +20% at Vultr), IPv4, bandwidth overage, managed vs unmanaged.

Which Black Friday VPS deals renew at the same price?

RackNerd: “Yes. These RackNerd VPS specials are lifetime recurring. You can renew at the same rate for as long as you decide to keep the service.” Hostinger, AwakeHost, ScalaHosting, Bluehost renew at a higher regular price (quotes in the table). netcup says promo prices stay the same at renewal, but has no Black Friday VPS price yet.

How much does a Hostinger Black Friday VPS cost after renewal?

KVM 1: $6.49/mo now, renews at $11.99/mo (+85%); KVM 2: $8.79/mo now, renews at $14.99/mo (+71%); KVM 4: $12.99/mo now, renews at $28.99/mo (+123%); KVM 8: $25.99/mo now, renews at $49.99/mo (+92%). Hostinger's page says the renewal is "for the same term", so renewing a 24-month plan is billed up front again (KVM 2: $359.76). Cash by month 25: KVM 1 $443.52, KVM 2 $570.72, KVM 4 $1,007.52, KVM 8 $1,823.52.

When does the Hostinger Black Friday sale end?

Hostinger's Black Friday page says: "The Hostinger Black Friday sale runs from October 19 to December 14, 2026." (read 2026-10-31). Prices can change during the sale; re-check before you pay.

Do I have to prepay to get the Black Friday VPS price?

It depends on the vendor: RackNerd 12 months up front; Hostinger 24 months up front; AwakeHost 1 month (billed monthly) up front; ScalaHosting 12 months or 36 months up front; Bluehost 24 months up front. Hostinger's page says "All plans are paid upfront". OVHcloud, Vultr and DigitalOcean plans in our table bill monthly with no prepay.
